name: compose-middleware
prompt: The tests in test/compose.test.js fail: our Koa-style compose() in src/compose.js does not wait for async middleware. Fix compose so the tests pass. It must follow Koa semantics: compose(middleware)(ctx, next?) returns a promise that settles when the whole chain has finished; next() returns a promise; an error thrown (synchronously or asynchronously) anywhere downstream rejects the upstream await next() and, if not caught, the returned promise; calling next() twice in one middleware rejects with an Error 'next() called multiple times'; the optional `next` passed to the composed function runs after the last middleware.
